title: 13 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Hot Flashes
intro: Herbal essential oils for hot flashes are a natural remedy that refers to highly concentrated plant extracts used to alleviate the symptoms of hot flashes, which are sudden, intense episodes of heat and sweating. The benefits of using herbal essential oils to treat hot flashes include reducing the frequency and severity of these episodes, promoting relaxation and calmness, and regulating hormonal balances. Some examples of herbal essential oils used to treat hot flashes include Clary Sage, which helps to calm the nervous system and reduce stress; Peppermint, which cools the body and alleviates symptoms of sweating; Fennel, which regulates hormonal balances and reduces hot flash episodes; and Geranium, which helps to balance estrogen levels and reduce symptoms of hot flashes. Additionally, other herbal essential oils such as Basil, Lavender, and Thyme have also been used to treat hot flashes due to their ability to reduce stress and promote relaxation.

preparations.preparation_desc: Valeriana officinalis essential oils have been traditionally used to treat hot flashes in women, particularly those experiencing menopause. The anxiolytic and sedative properties of this herbal preparation help to reduce stress and anxiety levels, which are often triggers for hot flashes. The bioactive constituents of Valeriana officinalis, including valerenic acid and isovaleric acid, have been shown to interact with the body's GABA receptors, promoting relaxation and reducing symptoms of hot flashes. Regular use of Valeriana officinalis essential oils can help to alleviate hot flashes, improve sleep quality, and enhance overall well-being in women experiencing menopausal symptoms.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the "Electronic physician" study, Valeriana officinalis essential oils were found to be effective in the treatment of acute menopausal syndrome, specifically in reducing hot flashes, along with other medicinal plants.
